function.name: analyze_ui_screenshot
function.description: Analyze the current UI screenshot and return clickable controls, recognized text, semantic roles and exact screenshot coordinates. The tool host supplies the current screenshot to the executor; do not generate or pass image bytes from the model. Use this before clicking or navigating a graphical application. When the target is a web page or an Electron app that exposes a DevTools endpoint, pass the optional 'a11y' argument so accessibility-tree names and boxes are merged with the vision result.

include.description: Result groups to return. Use controls for clickable targets, elements for all fused elements, texts for OCR, metadata for runtime/timing details, or annotated_image for a Base64-rendered PNG. Default: controls,texts,metadata.

annotate.description: Include a Base64 annotated PNG in the JSON result.

a11y.description: Optional accessibility-tree channel. Use mode='cdp' with cdp_url when a Chrome/Electron DevTools endpoint is reachable, or mode='inline' with pre-collected elements. A matched control gains a11y_role/a11y_name/a11y_rect, unnamed icons receive semantic names, and a11y-only nodes are appended as clickable elements.

target.description: Index into the page targets reported by /json/list.

target_url.description: Pin the page by URL substring (stable in multi-tab desktops).

url.description: Optional page to navigate before the tree is read.

elements.description: Inline accessibility nodes, used when mode='inline'.
